title: taeniosapium goudotianum
intro: Taeniosapium goudotianum, commonly known as the "Sarang Semut" or "Candle Ant Plant", is a species of flowering plant in the family Celastraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine, particularly in Indonesia and Malaysia, to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Taeniosapium goudotianum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to treat wounds, infections, and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
